author: Warhammer
description:
Aeldari Vypers are sleek skimmers that offer a perfect compromise between the speed of a jetbike and the heavier armament of a grav-tank. This video will teach you exactly how to paint one. Follow along as Ollie shows you how sub-assemblies make the process easier and why the Vyper is so much fun to paint!

Here’s a list of the paints and tools we used in today’s video:

Base:
Abaddon Black 
Dryad Bark
Leadbelcher
Mephiston Red
Retributor Armour

Layer:
Baneblade Brown
Dark Reaper
Fire Dragon Bright
Thunderhawk Blue
White Scar
Wild Rider Red

Contrast:
Aethermatic Blue
Warp Lightning 

Shade:
Agrax Earthshade
Nuln Oil

Technical:
Lahmian Medium

Brushes:
L Base
S Layer
M Layer
S Dry
M Dry

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
